title: How this draft was checked
body: A session agent redrafted the page from its blueprint for #71. A fresh fact-checker read 82 claims: 79 held and 3 were imprecise. The register editor's 26 findings, 5 blocking, were applied, and a recheck held all 54 changed lines.

The blueprint was brought in line with the reviewed page after you approved it, so a later redraft keeps every fix. Each change rests on the code or a fact, and none changes the page's sections or the reader's path.

title: The example now typechecks
body: The draft typed the channel module over a local `Env` that named only the member database, which would not typecheck once the lookup read another binding. It now uses the generated `Cloudflare.Env`, as the example site does.

title: Failures name their log events
body: New facts let the page name what a failed sign-in writes: `auth.channel.requested` with its `unknown` and `lookup_failed` outcomes, and `auth.channel.send_failed` with its `error` field.
